## Description

Applies Graph Attention Networks (GATs) over multi-tier supply chain relational graphs to weight supplier-customer shock propagation and forecast cross-sectional stock earnings surprises.

## Where it may fit

Earnings season trading, supply chain disruption shocks, cross-sectional stock selection.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Hedge Funds, Systematic Long/Short Factor Funds.

## Required data

Supply-chain relational matrices, fundamental financial statements, stock return panels.

## Caveats

Supply-chain relational graph mapping must be updated periodically as corporate partnerships evolve.
